summary: Georgia lookout list places an Athens tower in Clarke County at 729 ft; no source found describes the site today or its status.

evidence.supports: Athens tower listed in Clarke County at 33.92556, -83.37028, 729 ft
Directory lists an Athens tower in Clarke County with no other detail
Second list entry named uga in Clarke County at 33.89688, -83.36460, 723 ft
The list's map was revised on 22 March 2016

notes_for_editor: Thin record: only a tower-list row (coordinates, elevation, county) and a name-and-county directory entry. Neither says when the tower was built, what it was, who staffed it, or whether it stands, so the story has no built, staffing or fate section and the status stays unknown. The list's 'datasheet' note is unexplained. The 'uga' row (GA271, gfc-012) is about 3.2 km almost due south in the same county (bearing about 171 degrees); it may be the same tower recorded twice or a second tower, and the record should be checked against it. Two searches and the cached Warnell Whitehall Forest page found no lookout at Whitehall Forest, and the cached National Historic Lookout Register pages have no Athens entry. The brief's record has no errors to correct. Story is short because the evidence is short. The list gives elevations as bare numbers with no unit; feet is inferred from the values, as in the house style.
